story.title: Why we built Misbah
paragraphs: Many independent teachers have real expertise and a unique teaching style, but they lack a digital presence that reflects that. Meanwhile, many students and parents are looking for a suitable teacher and can't find a reliable way to reach one.
Academies take large commissions from teachers and add costs for students. The teacher loses independence, and the student pays more than they should.
Misbah bridges this gap: a professional directory showcasing only serious teachers, with manual review and clear standards, and direct contact with no middleman.

standards.title: Acceptance Standards
standards.intro: To join Misbah, you must meet:
points: Individual independent teacher — not an academy or institution
Professional educational video — shows actual teaching style
Acceptable presentation quality — clear writing, clear audio, organized content
Commitment to professionalism — no exaggeration, no suspicious claims

boundaries.title: What Misbah does not do
points: We don't intervene in the relationship between student and teacher
We don't book lessons or schedule appointments
We don't guarantee teaching quality — we only provide clear acceptance standards
We don't rank or rate teachers

items.question: What is Misbah?
items.answer: Misbah is a professional directory for serious independent teachers of Quran, Arabic, and Islamic Studies. Not a general directory — we review quality and professionalism before acceptance.

items.question: What are the acceptance standards for Misbah?
items.answer: We require: individual independent teacher, professional educational video showing teaching style, acceptable presentation quality, and commitment to professionalism. We reject those who don't meet the standards.

items.question: Is every teacher accepted?
items.answer: No. We review each application and reject those who don't meet quality and professionalism standards.

items.question: How much are the joining fees?
items.answer: Currently: First 30 founding teachers get 3-6 months free + lifetime special pricing. After beta: 1500-3000 EGP/year (much cheaper than academy commissions of 30-70%).

items.question: Does Misbah guarantee teaching quality?
items.answer: No. We review professionalism in presentation and seriousness, but we don't guarantee teaching quality or results. Students are responsible for choosing the right teacher.

items.question: Are there fees for students?
items.answer: No. Browsing is completely free for students. Subscription is for teachers only.

items.question: Does Misbah handle payments between student and teacher?
items.answer: No. Any financial arrangement between student and teacher happens completely independently outside the site.

items.question: Do I need a specific qualification?
items.answer: We look for seriousness and relevant experience, not formal degrees. You need a teaching sample video and clear information about your background.

items.question: Can I teach in person?
items.answer: Currently, Misbah focuses on online teaching only. This may expand in the future.

items.question: What if my application is rejected?
items.answer: You will receive feedback on what needs to change. You can reapply after making adjustments.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Yes. Your profile will be hidden after the subscription period ends. No refunds for partial periods.
